messages:
sam_s: POC with Orion Health - they're hitting intermittent SSE disconnects and partial JSON chunks that break their React Native EventSource polyfill. ~10% of streams. request id: req_0a1b2c3d

elaine_dev: can you paste the client's error + a raw stream capture? also are they behind a proxy/Cloudflare/ALB? those often buffer. :thinking:

maria_orion: console error: "SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input". fetch handler shows 200 then connection close mid-payload. using eventsource polyfill in RN. sample chunk we see:

  chunk: '{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello' ... (truncated)

support-bot: logs for req_0a1b2c3d: upstream response closed (499) after 3.4s; bytes_sent: 412; model: gpt-4o-mini; region: us-west-2

ryan_infra: 499 means client closed. common causes: client timeout, intermediate proxy buffering/closing, or polyfill giving up. repro steps:
1) curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" <url> to inspect raw SSE
2) confirm client accumulates until a full SSE event (don't parse partial chunk as JSON)

example:
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams

elaine_dev: also try Accept-Encoding: identity to disable gzip. some CDNs buffer compressed frames and then flush/close which looks like truncated jumps. RN polyfills sometimes time out too.

maria_orion: we're behind FastEdge edge proxy. curl shows our server sends keepalive comments but the edge strips them. our client times out after 6s and closes. any server-side knobs for hosted API?

sam_s: we can enable more frequent keepalives for the tenant or temporarily route the POC to a dedicated pool to avoid some edge buffering. @ryan_infra is per-tenant heartbeat possible for debugging?

ryan_infra: yes - I can enable an experimental short-heartbeat for that tenant/request. also recommend either increasing client timeout or using NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) as a fallback; NDJSON is easier for fragile clients. I'll enable heartbeat for req_0a1b2c3d and check FastEdge buffering settings (proxy_buffering / X-Accel-Buffering).

elaine_dev: if they can't change client quickly, we can provide a small RN parser snippet that accumulates partial data and JSON.parse when complete. sketch:
let buf = ''
source.onmessage = (e) => { buf += e.data; try { const obj = JSON.parse(buf); handle(obj); buf = ''; } catch(e) { /* wait for next chunk */ } }

support-bot: heartbeat enabled for req_0a1b2c3d at 1779256920. keepalive interval set to 2s for 24h debugging window. (experimental)

maria_orion: re-testing now...

maria_orion: one disconnect after 11s but the client parser recovered on the next chunk. much improved, will run 24h and report top failures with timestamps.

sam_s: next steps:
- ryan_infra: confirm FastEdge buffering behavior and any proxy config changes (recommend proxy_buffering off / X-Accel-Buffering: no / disable gzip where possible)
- elaine_dev: provide NDJSON envelope example + RN parser diff/snippet
- maria_orion: validate for 24h and post failure logs with timestamps and curl capture

Can we screenshare 9am PST tomorrow to watch a repro? @maria_orion

maria_orion: yes 9am PST works.

sam_s: I'll open a follow-up with meeting link and include a minimal curl reproduction for the customer. :thumbsup:

(thumbs-up reactions across thread)
